is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s., An. arabiensis, and An. funestus s.s. (Page 1, Methods).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study protocol explicitly states it will monitor L1014S-kdr, L1014F-kdr, G119S-ace1, L119F-GSTe2, CYP6P9a, and CYP6P9b (Page 6, Genotypic insecticide resistance monitoring).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: This is a study protocol paper describing planned research. It does not contain any empirical genotype data or results.

african_field_population.evidence: The study is set in Muheza District, Tanzania (Page 1, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary study protocol.

sub_country_location.evidence: Muheza District, Tanga Region, Tanzania (Page 1, Methods).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study is a planned 12-month post-intervention monitoring period (Page 4, Study design).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a protocol paper for a new trial.

supplement.evidence: The paper is a protocol and does not contain data results.

assessment.summary: This is a study protocol for a cluster-randomized trial in Muheza, Tanzania, evaluating the efficacy of broflanilide (VECTRON T500) for indoor residual spraying. As a protocol paper, it does not report any empirical genotype or bioassay data.
